lines.t: With your shoe, I let it show
Then your voice broke through, call me by my name
Now I'm running free, nothing stays the same
Heart is beating faster, feel the fire rise
Chains are falling off, see the truth in my eyes
From the dark to light, I was made to shine
Fearless glow, with Yahushua I rise
Brighter than the stars, shining in His eyes
Every step I dance, every fear I leave Fearless glow, Yahushua in me
Used to hide my scars, now they tell your story Every broken piece, now it sings your glory
No more looking back, future calls my name With your power in me, nothing looks the same
Heart's beating faster, feel the fire rise
Chains are falling off, see the truth in my eyes
From the dark to light, I was made to shine
Fearless glow, with Yahushua I rise
Brighter than the stars, shining in His eyes
Every step I dance, every fear I leave
Though I was lost in the crowd, now I'm standing tall
Yahushua called my name, answered every call
No more fake, no more chains, living for the king
Light inside me bursting, watch the horror scene
From the ashes to the throne, chosen not alone
Feelings with its power, now the stage is home
